synthesis.guidance: Use React Aria behavior as a contract for an existing React overlay, not a reason to rebuild focus logic from a snippet. Wire title and container props together; alertdialog descriptions have a separate slot and role-specific handling. The inspected implementation delays initial focus while isEntering is true, preserves focus already inside, and enables overlay focus containment, with Safari/VoiceOver workarounds. Retain library behavior rather than copying its timeout in isolation. Keep entry motion brief, honor reduced motion, and make hierarchy readable without animation. Use a product-specific heading and consequence text rather than an ornamental modal hero. This is internal source, not a standalone public import example; verify the installed public hook API. Full Apache license and NOTICE are retained. No Spectrum icon package, font, logo, dependency or notice outbound link was fetched or bundled.

synthesis.summary: The inspected useDialog contract exposes dialogProps, titleProps and alert-dialog contentProps, with isEntering delaying focus until entry animation completes. A behavior reference for custom branded overlays.
